title: ID0399056-DC/Si-D/FI-[nqq1M7] - Display partly cracked.
description:

Customer noticed that the screen is cracked. colleague visited on site and he couldnt see any sign of vandalizm or misuse. Looks like all the cracks are behind the glass panel. With finger you cannot feel any edges.

Quality issue
